field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable this NetBird instance

field.label: Name
field.help: A short name to identify this instance (e.g. the client/account it connects to)

field.label: Enable CARP Failover Support
field.help: When enabled, this instance will start on MASTER state and stop on BACKUP state.

field.label: WireGuard Interface
field.help: Name of the WireGuard tunnel interface NetBird creates for this instance, e.g. wt0. Must be unique across instances.

field.label: WireGuard Port
field.help: Wireguard interface listening port. Must be unique across instances.

field.label: Force IP Mapping
field.help: Forces external IPs maps between local addresses and interfaces. You can specify a comma-separated list with the following: a single IP (12.34.56.78), IP/IP (12.34.56.78/10.0.0.1) or IP/device (12.34.56.80/em1). Leave empty for automatic mapping.

field.label: Management URL
field.help: The NetBird management server this instance connects to

field.label: Setup Key
field.help: Setup key used to register this instance with the management server

field.label: Enable Firewall
field.help: Allow the client to filter traffic with its built-in firewall. If disabled, you must assign the NetBird interface and manage firewall rules via OPNsense firewall management. Additionally, NetBird routing and DNS may not function as intended.

field.label: Block Inbound Connection
field.help: Block all inbound connections to the local machine from the WireGuard interface and any routed networks

field.label: Enable
field.help: Allows incoming SSH connections

field.label: Enable Root Login
field.help: Allow root user login

field.label: Enable SFTP
field.help: Enable SFTP subsystem for file transfers

field.label: Enable Local Port Forwarding
field.help: Allow clients to forward local ports through the server

field.label: Enable Remote Port Forwarding
field.help: Allow clients to request remote port forwarding

field.label: Enable SSH Authentication
field.help: Enable JWT authentication for SSH connections. When disabled, allows any peer with network access

field.label: Enable
field.help: Allows the client to resolve and configure DNS on the host

field.label: Access LAN
field.help: Allow access to local networks (LAN) when using this peer as a routing peer or exit-node

field.label: Accept Client Routes
field.help: Accept and process client routes received from the management

field.label: Accept Server Routes
field.help: Enable this peer to act as a router for server routes received from the management

field.label: Enable Rosenpass
field.help: Enable the Rosenpass to provide post-quantum secure connections (Experimental)

field.label: Rosenpass Permissive Mode
field.help: Enable Rosenpass permissive mode
